heroHeadline: Trump Rules Out Strike on Iran Before Midterms as Vance Presses for Enrichment Cuts
heroSubtitle: Trump said on October 9 the US will not strike Iran before the November 3 midterms, calling talks productive, while Iran reviews a US proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. VP Vance has demanded a meaningful cut in enrichment capacity; Tehran says it will not abandon enrichment.
